description.value: Loriz - Our Daily Bread is a Filipino specialty bakery offering traditional breads including pandesal, ensaymada, Spanish bread, monay, and pan de coco. The bakery emphasizes authentic island baking traditions rooted in Philippine culinary heritage, with a product line spanning sweet buns, savoury buns, empanadas, and hopia pastries. Cyclists stopping in would find a distinctive selection of Filipino baked goods not commonly found at mainstream grocery stops.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website was fetched successfully and confirms a Filipino specialty bakery selling pandesal, ensaymada, pan de coco, and other traditional breads. However, several red flags emerged: the website phone number carries a 780 area code (Edmonton, Alberta, not BC), the site title is the WordPress default 'My blog – Just another WordPress site', cake descriptions contain Lorem ipsum placeholder text, and no physical address appears anywhere on the site. The OSM coordinates (49.192°N, 122.824°W) place this location in the Surrey/Delta area of BC, not North Vancouver as listed in the community field. None of the required WWC cycling amenities (bike parking, water refill) are mentioned on the website.
concerns: Website phone number (780) 487-0388 is an Alberta area code, not a BC area code — may indicate the discovered URL belongs to a different business or is a placeholder site.
Website title is the WordPress default 'My blog – Just another WordPress site'; cake descriptions contain Lorem ipsum placeholder text, suggesting the site may not be fully set up for this business.
OSM community is listed as 'North Vancouver' but coordinates (49.192°N, 122.824°W) correspond to the Surrey/Delta area of BC, not North Vancouver (~49.32°N, 123.07°W).
No physical street address available in OSM tags or on the website.
Email address on website appears malformed: 'info@lorizbakerycom' (missing dot before 'com').
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Multiple data quality concerns prevent confident inclusion: the website phone number uses a 780 area code (Alberta, not BC), the site contains Lorem ipsum placeholder text and a default WordPress title suggesting an incomplete or template site, no physical address is available, and the OSM community field ('North Vancouver') does not match the coordinates which fall in the Surrey/Delta area. Human verification of the actual business location and operating status is needed before listing.
